narr: A narrow band of slow moving thunderstorms dumped 2 to 5 inches of rain in a small area of Lauderdale County near Killen during the late evening hours. This resulted in isolated flash flooding and at least one tree being knocked down.
ev: Water over both westbound lanes at Hickory Park Rd and Hwy 72. Depth of water estimated at 6 inches.
